entities.summary: The Sochi agreement, also known as the Dagomys Agreements, was a ceasefire agreement ostensibly marking the end of both the South Ossetia War and Abkhazian War, signed in Sochi on June 24, 1992 between Georgia and Russia, the ceasefire with Abkhazia on July 27, 1993.
